description: What each of the workspace's connected accounts has gained since it joined Chockstone (the day it was connected): followers then and now, views since joining with views a day before and after, reach, profile views and link taps added up by day, minutes watched and posts made here. YouTube's views, minutes watched and subscribers are read live from YouTube Analytics. Other networks use the numbers they reported each day; numbers recorded with account_stats_record don't count here. Views a day before joining exist where the network gave its past days at connect (Instagram, Pinterest, Google Business Profile) or reports them live (YouTube).

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
